description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionMigrationUtil class, focusing on migrating connection JSON data, especially authorization contexts, sources, targets, and header mappings within an Eclipse Ditto messaging service project.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtilTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the migration of connection JSON objects, including authorization contexts, sources, targets, filters, and header mappings within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework.

methods.name: migrateConnectionWithGlobalAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Test that a connection JSON containing a global authorization context is correctly migrated, with authorization contexts applied to sources and targets.

methods.name: migrateConnectionContainingSourcesAndTargetsWithOwnAuthContextWithGlobalAuthContext
methods.description: Test migration of a connection JSON where sources and targets have their own auth contexts with fallback to a global auth context.

methods.name: migrateSourceWithFilters
methods.description: Test that source filters are correctly migrated and assigned Enforcement objects for sources.

methods.name: migrateSourcesWithoutFiltersJsonIsNotTouched
methods.description: Ensure that if sources do not contain filters, the JSON remains unchanged during migration.

methods.name: migratePlaceholderTopicActionSubject
methods.description: Verify that placeholder topics in header mappings and target addresses are correctly migrated and formatted.
